rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip, matched to a single user, and accessed only that user’s data. It checked the most recent pending order, identified the current item (1000ml glass) and clarified the discrepancy. It consulted product availability, proposed only in-stock 1000ml alternatives, and the user selected 1000ml stainless steel black. The agent effectively obtained confirmation via the user’s explicit choice, restated the exact change, then modified the pending order. The tool confirms the item was replaced with the correct variant and a refund of the correct price difference ($3.21) was issued. Final information given to the user matches the tool results. One minor quibble is that the agent proceeded immediately after restating the change rather than explicitly waiting for a “yes,” but the user’s selection reasonably constitutes explicit confirmation. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
